name: Log + Deadlift Peak
subtitle: 31 October 2026 competition peak
notes: Four balanced training sessions each week: Log/Upper, Deadlift/Back, Legs, and Strongman. Competition lifts stay specific, but each session includes a broad spread of supporting movements. Warm-ups are capped at five useful blood-flow, mobility/stretching and activation drills; lift-specific ramp sets sit in the main-lift notes instead of bloating the warm-up checklist. The empty log is 80 kg.
